result_kind: simulated (behavioural model B loaded with T-extracted corner parameters)
cross_check: incomplete: DR-001's in-band-SNDR leg is not computable at the committed 1024-clock T record (see sndr_inband_db.reason), so DR-001 item 3 acceptance cannot be declared at any corner. Computable legs: inband_power_3db, span_10pct, duty_0p05. Model B numbers at this corner are reported uncross-checked and are not used for row 2.

dc_gain.why: OTA open-loop gain from the 1-1000 Hz AC asymptote; one OTA type serves both integrators, so one value enters the pole of both (model.py p = A/(A+1)).

settling_error.why: residual error at the 97.66 ns sample instant of the phi2 integrate phase, relative to the settled step, on the #92-switch-fixed cell; variant int1 is stage-phasing case B (0.1 pF load), which is the phasing the assembled delaying loop presents (sim/integrator-settling/README.md). This record is the one whose integrator_netlist_sha256 matches the tree.

ci_offset.why: nominal per-clock differential charge-injection residual in FS units, post-#92 cell (variant post_v0). At most corners it sits at the bench's own vntol floor (1e-7 V = 8.3e-8 FS). PDK-mismatch spread is a Monte Carlo quantity (issue #34, out of scope); record-mc.json puts the switch-attributable sigma at 59-90 uV per clock (4.9e-05..7.5e-05 FS) and the study value at sim/integrator-ci/bmodel-ci-injection.json.

ktc_noise_var.why: white per-event variance (FS^2) that reproduces the measured in-band thermal noise through model B's own 1/OSR link: the sampling-switch kT/C part plus the integrate-phase amplifier part referred where it accumulates, across Ci (the #140 correction; the static referral over-counts and is recorded beside it as 8.305992e-07). Flicker is inside the amplifier share: ngspice .noise gives no thermal/flicker split per corner, so the model draws it white. Misses the spec 5.3 budget by -11.3 dB at tt (total_thermal_accumulated_pass false) -- issue #138, open, recorded not fixed.

comparator_offset.why: input-referred offset from the staircase trip points (v_trip_up + v_trip_dn)/2, resolved to +/- half the staircase step at each corner (the per-corner quantization block).

comparator_hysteresis.why: v_trip_up - v_trip_dn: an UPPER BOUND on the hysteresis width (a comparator with none reads one whole staircase step); the lower bound is 0. The upper bound is the conservative value for model B (sim/comparator-decision/README.md, model_b_units).

ci_gain_error.why: no T source: the signal-dependent part of charge injection is below the integrator-ci bench's resolution (the slope it fits is accounted for by the drawn capacitor ratio, the finite-gain leak and, at slow/cold corners, the incomplete input sampling of #106). The per-corner BOUND is -0.0101 (derived.per_corner.ff/1.980V/-40C.ci_gain_error_bound) and is recorded here, not entered: entering a bound as a value would double-count the gain deficit the bench attributes elsewhere.

jitter_rms_s.why: no T source: clock jitter is a DR-001 item 2 parameter but no bench extracts it -- every T bench drives behavioural rail-to-rail clocks with no non-overlap generator, and design/clkgen has no jitter extraction. Entered 0 (the ideal value), not a measurement.
